newsitem.title: EGYPT: Spain's king meets Egyptian president in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Spain's king meets Egyptian president in Cairo.

text.p: Spanish King Juan Carlos met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Tuesday.
The king was warmly embraced by Mubarak at the Ittihadiya presidential palace. The two leaders exchanged gifts before entering a closed meeting.

King Juan Carlos arrived in Cairo on Monday with his wife Queen Sophia on his first state visit to Egypt since 1977. The Spanish government hopes the three-day trip will be an opportunity to drum up business in Egypt for Spanish companies.
The economic highlight of the visit will be a meeting between Spanish and Egyptian businessmen on Wednesday. Spain is the 13th largest source of Egyptian imports.
Speakers will include King Juan Carlos, Egyptian Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid, Economy Minister Nawal el-Tatawi and possibly Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri.
King Juan Carlos and Queen Sophia, who spent part of her childhood in Egypt, were due to make a private visit to the southern resort of Luxor on Thursday.
